summary: Your eighteenth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on injection, leakage, allow-lists, audit logs and excessive agency with a confidence number, keep a threat table with an honest last column, extend your glossary, read your audit log as an investigator, add a security story to your applications, tag week 18 and plan week 19.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Write your threat table: where each enters, what stops it today, what does not
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold and read the audit log as an investigator
Count this week's applications and add a sentence about your security work
Run git tag week-18, then plan week 19 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 2 or 3 applications
Play the Security Mix-up game to the end and see your score
